title: Compatible algebraic stalk trivialization of a uniform finite perfect quotient diagram
statement: Let X be locally Noetherian and quasi-compact [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], d an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and M in D(Mod(B_X)) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Fix quotient-compatible and scalar-compatible isomorphisms between the constant quotient rings and the finite coefficient rings. If M has uniform finite perfect quotient models [lem-weil-pbc-residue-perfect-finite-quotient-models], there is a pro-etale covering on each member of which the entire restricted levelwise diagram of its specified strict derived quotient system is isomorphic to completed constant realization of one normalized algebraic quotient system. The algebraic system includes left adjoints to level and consecutive exact scalar restriction, its normalization transposes are isomorphisms, and its residue object is perfect [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. No completeness of A or M, inverse-limit identification, or choice of a perfect A-model is asserted.

source.place: Tag 09C6, lemma-connected-adic-lisse: the etale origins and normalized algebraic stalk diagram, with compatible local markings (Tags 09B1 and 09BV).

proof.text: Obtain an etale cover with a fixed normalized algebraic stalk tower and separate local markings at each level.
For each chart obtain the finite locally constant Isom-sheaf tower, nonempty geometric stalks, and reduction-compatible evaluation on affine weakly contractible objects and their restrictions.
Apply the existing finite-lisse tower section-cover theorem to obtain compatible sections on one pro-etale cover of each chart; compose these with the initial etale cover.

On every member of the generated covering sieve, evaluate the sections after restriction along its factorization through a covering object. The section equations and evaluation square give consecutive naturality. NatTrans.ofOpSequence supplies naturality for all arrows; component invertibility makes the transformation an isomorphism. Package it with the chosen algebraic tower.

theorem finitePerfectAdicTower_extraction
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d))
    (hmodels : HasUniformFinitePerfectModels X d φ M) :
    ∃ S : Sieve (⊤_ X.ProEt), S ∈ ProEt.topology X (⊤_ X.ProEt) ∧
      ∀ (U : X.ProEt) (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ X.ProEt), S f →
        Nonempty (FinitePerfectAdicLocalTower X d U ((completedAdicReduction X d).obj M))
lean.note: K6: original data declarations are preserved verbatim in the publicly imported FinitePerfectAdicTowerData module, attached to def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data. Common-cover construction and diagram assembly are proved from the two strictly finite-level obligations and the existing finite-lisse section-cover theorem.
